propositions: Plan-review PASS verdicts on mutating public routes (CLI review-plan, library review_plan) must sign and persist a claim-valid attestation by default, not opt-in
Explicit unsigned execution requires --no-sign flag (CLI) or sign=False parameter (library); omission of these flags must result in signing
Non-signable verdicts (BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded results) and explicit sign=False must remain unsigned; guards are enforced at the attest.sign_plan_review boundary
Idempotent re-invocation with a current claim-valid attestation reuses it without an LLM call or duplicate signature event
A PASS with signature-persistence failure returns a retryable nonzero disposition and identifies sign-review as the recovery path

Documentation (help text, CLI reference, user guide, LLM framework, plan-review gate) accurately describes sign-on-PASS default, explicit opt-out syntax, never-sign outcomes, and sign-review recovery path
